result.instructions: Tools for Axis LMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which learners have not completed the Safety Basics course, and when did they start?"; "List the certifications that expire in the next 60 days."; "Enroll user 142 in the onboarding learning path and add them to the New Hires usergroup.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Axis LMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run axislms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run axislms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run axislms_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. axislms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: axislms_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the LMS users (id and username only), active, inactive or all. Not paged: a large LMS returns every user. For names, emails or filters use axislms_search_users. GET /users/list/{status}/.

tools.name: axislms_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One user by id with the fields you ask for: profile (name, email, address, phone, custom1-15, role, manager_id, dates), usergroups, enrolled courses, ILT classes, certifications, learning paths, badges, organizations and system variables. Contains personal data. GET /users/{id}/?fields=.

user_id.description: Axis user id (from axislms_list_users or axislms_search_users).

fields.description: User fields to return (default: id and username). The first field is also the sort key. The sso login link is not available.

tools.name: axislms_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Page through all users, or only those matching a search phrase (for example email~example.com,role=manager), returning the fields you ask for. Contains personal data. GET /users/all/ or /users/filtered/ (page{n}).

user_filter.description: Axis user search phrase: field-name + operator + value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: = equals, != not equal, ~ contains, !~ does not contain; for usergroup, ~ means 'is in' and !~ 'is not in'. Fields: id, manager_id, org_id, branch_id, username, first_name, last_name, email, middle_init, company, address, city, state, zip, phone, custom1..custom15, localization, role, usergroup, date_start, date_expire. Examples: state=nj | email~example.com | manager_id=12,usergroup~sales,branch_id=50

fields.description: User fields to return (default: id and username). The first field is also the sort key. The sso login link is not available.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1); 100 records per page. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: axislms_count_users
tools.title: Count users
tools.description: Number of users, all or matching a search phrase. GET /users/all/count/ or /users/filtered/count/?user_filter=.

user_filter.description: Axis user search phrase: field-name + operator + value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: = equals, != not equal, ~ contains, !~ does not contain; for usergroup, ~ means 'is in' and !~ 'is not in'. Fields: id, manager_id, org_id, branch_id, username, first_name, last_name, email, middle_init, company, address, city, state, zip, phone, custom1..custom15, localization, role, usergroup, date_start, date_expire. Examples: state=nj | email~example.com | manager_id=12,usergroup~sales,branch_id=50

tools.name: axislms_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the active online courses (id and name), plus the count. GET /courses/list/.

tools.name: axislms_count_courses
tools.title: Count courses
tools.description: Number of active online courses. GET /courses/count/.

tools.name: axislms_get_course
tools.title: Get course
tools.description: One online course: name, catalog id, description, active flag, created/updated dates, keyword tags, passing score, price and whether it is for sale, thumbnail, webhook. GET /courses/{id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_course_users
tools.title: List users in a course
tools.description: Users enrolled in a course with their access start and end dates (YYYYMMDD): active, expired or all enrollments. GET /courses/{id}/users/{status}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_usergroups
tools.title: List usergroups
tools.description: List usergroups (id and name). GET /usergroups/list/.

tools.name: axislms_get_usergroup
tools.title: Get usergroup
tools.description: One usergroup: name, member counts (active, inactive, total) and owner. GET /usergroups/{id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_usergroup_members
tools.title: List usergroup members
tools.description: Members of a usergroup (id and username): active, inactive or all. GET /usergroups/{id}/members/{status}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_learningpaths
tools.title: List learning paths
tools.description: List the active learning paths (id and name). GET /learningpaths/list/.

tools.name: axislms_list_learningpath_users
tools.title: List users in a learning path
tools.description: Active enrolled users of a learning path (or one user), with status, start and completion time, completion method, path version, current branch and step, and progress. GET /learningpaths/{id}/users/[{user_id}/].

annotations.title: List users in a learning path

tools.name: axislms_list_certifications
tools.title: List certification programs
tools.description: List certification programs (id and name): active, inactive or all. GET /certifications/list/{status}/.

tools.name: axislms_get_certification
tools.title: Get certification program
tools.description: One certification program: name, prefix, description, keyword tags, webhook and status. GET /certifications/{program_id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_certification_users
tools.title: List certified users
tools.description: Users certified in a certification program (id and username). GET /certifications/{program_id}/users/.

tools.name: axislms_list_user_certificates
tools.title: List a user's certifications
tools.description: The certifications a user holds: program, certification number, issue, renew and expire dates (YYYYMMDD). GET /certifications/certificates/{user_id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_user_ceus
tools.title: List a user's CEU credits
tools.description: Continuing-education credits (CEUs) a user earned: type, name, credits and issue date. GET /certifications/ceus/{user_id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_ilt_programs
tools.title: List ILT programs
tools.description: List instructor-led training (ILT) programs (id and name). GET /ilt/list/.

tools.name: axislms_get_ilt_program
tools.title: Get ILT program
tools.description: One ILT program: name, catalog id, description and keyword tags. GET /ilt/{program_id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_ilt_sessions
tools.title: List ILT sessions
tools.description: Sessions of an ILT program with start and end dates and seats (total, reserved, remaining): current ones or all. GET /ilt/{program_id}/sessions/{current|all}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_ilt_meetings
tools.title: List ILT meetings
tools.description: Meetings of one ILT session: date, time, timezone, duration, GMT start and end, facility. GET /ilt/{program_id}/meetings/{session_id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_ilt_completions
tools.title: List ILT completions
tools.description: Users who completed an ILT program, or one session of it (id and username). GET /ilt/{program_id}/completions/[{session_id}/].

tools.name: axislms_list_user_ilt_sessions
tools.title: List a user's ILT sessions
tools.description: ILT sessions a user is part of: program, session, start and end dates and percent attended. GET /ilt/users/{user_id}/sessions/.

tools.name: axislms_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List organizations with owner id and user count, all or those owned by one manager (owner id 0 = the partition admin). GET /organizations/list/{all|owner_id}/.

owner_id.description: Only organizations owned by this manager's user id; omit for all.

tools.name: axislms_list_organization_branches
tools.title: List organization branches
tools.description: The branches of an organization (nested branches included). GET /organizations/branches/{organization_id}/.

tools.name: axislms_list_organization_users
tools.title: List organization users
tools.description: Users in an organization (id, username, branch id): active, inactive or all. GET /organizations/users/{organization_id}/{status}/.

Limited to users currently enrolled who accessed the course or have score data. Paged (100 per page). GET /reports/courses/{course_id}/.

tools.title: User transcript report

Contains personal data; paged (100 per page). GET /reports/users/{user_id|all|filtered}/{kind}/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1); 100 records per page. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

count_only.description: If true, return only the number of matching records (and pages) instead of the records.

tools.name: axislms_enroll_user_in_course
tools.title: Enroll a user in a course
tools.description: WRITE: enroll a user in an online course (optionally with access start and end dates). The user and the course must be active. If the user is already enrolled, send start or end to change the enrollment dates. Depending on the LMS settings the user may be notified. POST /courses/enrollments/{course_id}/{user_id}/.

end.description: Access end date, yyyy-mm-dd; must be after the start date.

annotations.title: Enroll a user in a course

tools.name: axislms_unenroll_user_from_course
tools.title: Remove a user from a course
tools.description: WRITE: remove a user from an online course. The user loses access to the course. DELETE /courses/enrollments/{course_id}/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Remove a user from a course

tools.name: axislms_enroll_user_in_learningpath
tools.title: Enroll a user in a learning path
tools.description: WRITE: enroll an active user in a learning path. The user must not already be enrolled. POST /learningpaths/enrollments/{learningpath_id}/users/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Enroll a user in a learning path

tools.name: axislms_unenroll_user_from_learningpath
tools.title: Remove a user from a learning path
tools.description: WRITE: remove a user from a learning path they are enrolled in. DELETE /learningpaths/enrollments/{learningpath_id}/users/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Remove a user from a learning path

tools.name: axislms_enroll_user_in_ilt_session
tools.title: Enroll a user in an ILT session
tools.description: WRITE: enroll a user in a session of an ILT program (takes a seat; check seats_remaining with axislms_list_ilt_sessions first). POST /ilt/enrollments/{program_id}/{session_id}/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Enroll a user in an ILT session

tools.name: axislms_unenroll_user_from_ilt_session
tools.title: Remove a user from an ILT session
tools.description: WRITE: remove a user from a session of an ILT program. DELETE /ilt/enrollments/{program_id}/{session_id}/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Remove a user from an ILT session

tools.name: axislms_mark_ilt_attendance
tools.title: Mark ILT attendance
tools.description: WRITE: mark a user attended or absent for one ILT meeting. The user must already be enrolled in the meeting. Attendance can count toward completion. PUT /ilt/attendance/{program_id}/{session_id}/{meeting_id}/{user_id}/{attended|absent}/.

tools.name: axislms_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: WRITE: create a new LMS user. The username must be 4-40 characters (letters, numbers, @ . _ -) and not in use. Returns the new user id. The temporary password the LMS generates is never shown here: give the person access through the LMS itself (its password reset, invitation or single sign-on). Depending on the LMS settings the user may be notified. POST /users/.

localization.description: A language pack name installed in the LMS.

tools.name: axislms_update_user
tools.title: Update a user
tools.description: WRITE: change profile fields of an existing user (only the fields you send are changed; an empty value is not sent, so a field cannot be cleared here). This edits personal data and can change the user's role or manager. PUT /users/{user_id}/.

localization.description: A language pack name installed in the LMS.

tools.name: axislms_create_usergroup
tools.title: Create a usergroup
tools.description: WRITE: create a usergroup. The name must be 4-99 characters (letters, numbers, spaces and @ . _ -). Returns its id. POST /usergroups/{name}/.

tools.name: axislms_add_usergroup_member
tools.title: Add a user to a usergroup
tools.description: WRITE: add a user to a usergroup (they must not already be a member). Groups can drive course or path assignments. POST /usergroups/members/{usergroup_id}/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Add a user to a usergroup

tools.name: axislms_remove_usergroup_member
tools.title: Remove a user from a usergroup
tools.description: WRITE: remove a user from a usergroup they are a member of. DELETE /usergroups/members/{usergroup_id}/{user_id}/.

annotations.title: Remove a user from a usergroup
